claims: White Fox joins Marvel Rivals as a Strategist hero in Season 7.
Marvel Rivals Season 7 launches on March 20, 2026.
White Fox is a nine-tailed fox (Kumiho).
White Fox specializes in healing allies and damaging enemies using "Yeowoo Guseul" (fox marbles).
White Fox's kit includes charm abilities.
White Fox's ultimate transforms her into a giant nine-tailed fox.
White Fox's ultimate buffs teammates with "Unstoppable" effects.
White Fox's ultimate buffs teammates with "Lifesteal" effects.
White Fox features a unique Team-Up ability with Luna Snow.
